# vendor/

Offline copies of the web libraries and fonts used by `sysmodel serve` (no network needed). Fetched 2026-10-10.

- `rough.js` - roughjs 4.6.6, from https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/roughjs@4.6.6/bundled/rough.js (MIT, `LICENSES/roughjs-LICENSE`)
- `elk.bundled.js` - elkjs 0.9.3, from https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/elkjs@0.9.3/lib/elk.bundled.js (EPL-2.0, `LICENSES/elkjs-LICENSE.md`)
- `fonts.css` + `fonts/*.woff2` - Patrick Hand and Atkinson Hyperlegible (400, 700), latin and latin-ext subsets only, from https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Patrick+Hand&family=Atkinson+Hyperlegible:wght@400;700&display=swap (woff2 files from fonts.gstatic.com; SIL OFL 1.1, `LICENSES/PatrickHand-OFL.txt` and `LICENSES/AtkinsonHyperlegible-OFL.txt`)
- OFL texts fetched from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/google/fonts/main/ofl/patrickhand/OFL.txt and .../atkinsonhyperlegible/OFL.txt
